translate_en|mods/Better Dressed/42.13/m: Double-click an item to Transmog your clothing.
Click Hide to hide the item.
Click Reset to set the item back to Default.
Click Show to show the item.
Remove transmogs from all worn items
Removes the Transmog from this item (tint/texture will remain)
Reset all worn items to default
Resets this item to it's original state
Restores visibility of all worn items
Restores visibility of the selected item
Disable Hat and Masks Hard Fix
Requires client reboot: If disabled, when transmogging a hat or mask to invisible, you hair style might appear squished. But hats and mask will now appear on the floor, and on zombies
When you enable the Immersive Mode from the sandbox settings, you can transmog only to the items you have found, and if you die, don't worry! You will keep your list of found transmogs :D
Limit Transmog To The Same Body Location
Eg: you can only transmog hats to hats, and trousers to trousers, but not trousers to hats, or different body locations
